verdict.rationale: The only SDK-specific evidence is an Adyen doc page titled 'install-auth-sdk' for business accounts, which describes device binding. That shows a first-party SDK exists, but only a narrow authentication one. The rest of the pack documents raw APIs (Legal Entity Management, Configuration), webhooks and an MCP server, none of which are official SDKs. Missing for 10: documented server-side or client SDK libraries for the platform APIs, language coverage, SDK reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
